knowledge:
- key_parameters: rankName=Taxonomic rank to collapse input taxa (e.g., "class", "phylum") ;; refTaxon=Reference taxon used to order species by increasing taxonomic distance ;; var1AggregateBy/var2AggregateBy=Method to aggregate additional variables when collapsing into supertaxa (e.g., "max", "mean") ;; var1Cutoff/var2Cutoff=Cutoff thresholds for the two additional variables ;; percentCutoff=Cutoff for the percentage of species present in a supertaxon ;; coorthologCutoffMax=Maximum allowed number of co-orthologs ;; coreCoverage=The percentage of taxa that must be present in the selected set for core gene identification
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing the presence-absence patterns of genes/orthologs across species, especially when integrating multi-layered information (like sequence similarity, domain architecture) and wanting to estimate gene age, identify core genes, or visualize profiles dynamically
- pitfalls: Orthology inference is not error-free, and orthology does not guarantee functional equivalence. Downstream analysis results can change substantially upon filtering, so users should use distribution analysis (via createVarDistPlot) to decide on reasonable filtering thresholds.

workflows.name: profile_processing_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Process raw orthology input data, generate a phylogenetic profile, and visualize it as a heatmap.
input: rawInput.txt (tab-delimited text file containing orthology data with columns like geneID, ncbiID, orthoID, and optional additional variables)
workflows.stages: 1. Process raw input into a phylogenetic profile using fromInputToProfile ;; 2. Prepare data for plotting using dataMainPlot ;; 3. Define plot parameters and generate the heatmap using heatmapPlotting
workflows.code:
rawInput <- system.file(
    "extdata", "test.main.long", package = "PhyloProfile", mustWork = TRUE
)
rankName <- "class"
refTaxon <- "Mammalia"
taxaTree <- NULL
sortedTaxonList <- NULL
var1AggregateBy <- "max"
var2AggregateBy <- "mean"
percentCutoff <- c(0.0, 1.0)
coorthologCutoffMax <- 10
var1Cutoff <- c(0.75, 1.0)
var2Cutoff <- c(0.5, 1.0)
var1Relation <- "protein"
var2Relation <- "species"
groupByCat <- FALSE
catDt <- NULL
profileData <- fromInputToProfile(
    rawInput,
    rankName,
    refTaxon,
    taxaTree,
    sortedTaxonList,
    var1AggregateBy,
    var2AggregateBy,
    percentCutoff,
    coorthologCutoffMax,
    var1Cutoff,
    var2Cutoff,
    var1Relation,
    var2Relation,
    groupByCat,
    catDt
)
head(profileData)
data("finalProcessedProfile", package="PhyloProfile")
plotDf <- dataMainPlot(finalProcessedProfile)
plotParameter <- list(
    "xAxis" = "taxa",
    "var1ID" = "FAS_FW",
    "var2ID"  = "FAS_BW",
    "midVar1" = 0.5,
    "midColorVar1" =  "#FFFFFF",
    "lowColorVar1" =  "#FF8C00",
    "highColorVar1" = "#4682B4",
    "midVar2" = 1,
    "midColorVar2" =  "#FFFFFF",
    "lowColorVar2" = "#CB4C4E",
    "highColorVar2" = "#3E436F",
    "paraColor" = "#07D000",
    "xSize" = 8,
    "ySize" = 8,
    "legendSize" = 8,
    "mainLegend" = "top",
    "dotZoom" = 0,
    "xAngle" = 60,
    "guideline" = 0,
    "colorByGroup" = FALSE,
    "colorByOrthoID" = FALSE
)
p <- heatmapPlotting(plotDf, plotParameter)
p

workflows.name: downstream_profile_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform downstream evolutionary and comparative analyses (clustering, gene age estimation, core gene identification, and group comparison) on processed phylogenetic profiles.
input: processedProfile.RData (processed phylogenetic profile data frame containing taxonomy information and aggregated variables)
workflows.stages: 1. Cluster profiles using getDataClustering, getDistanceMatrix, clusterDataDend, and getDendrogram ;; 2. Estimate gene age using sortInputTaxa and estimateGeneAge ;; 3. Identify core genes using getCoreGene ;; 4. Compare taxon groups using compareTaxonGroups
workflows.code:
data("finalProcessedProfile", package="PhyloProfile")
data <- finalProcessedProfile
profileType <- "binary"
profiles <- getDataClustering(
    data, profileType, var1AggregateBy, var2AggregateBy)
method <- "mutualInformation"
distanceMatrix <- getDistanceMatrix(profiles, method)
clusterMethod <- "complete"
dd <- clusterDataDend(as.dist(distanceMatrix), clusterMethod)
getDendrogram(dd)

data("fullProcessedProfile", package="PhyloProfile")
rankName <- "class"
refTaxon <- "Mammalia"
taxonIDs <- levels(as.factor(fullProcessedProfile$ncbiID))
sortedInputTaxa <- sortInputTaxa(
    taxonIDs, rankName, refTaxon, NULL, NULL, NULL
)
library(dplyr)
taxaCount <- sortedInputTaxa %>% dplyr::count(supertaxon)
var1Cutoff <- c(0,1)
var2Cutoff <- c(0,1)
percentCutoff <- c(0,1)
estimateGeneAge(
    fullProcessedProfile, taxaCount, rankName, refTaxon,
    var1Cutoff, var2Cutoff, percentCutoff
)

data("fullProcessedProfile", package="PhyloProfile")
rankName <- "class"
refTaxon <- "Mammalia"
taxaCore <- c("Mammalia", "Saccharomycetes", "Insecta")
var1Cutoff <- c(0.75, 1.0)
var2Cutoff <- c(0.75, 1.0)
percentCutoff <- c(0.0, 1.0)
coreCoverage <- 1
taxonIDs <- levels(as.factor(fullProcessedProfile$ncbiID))
sortedInputTaxa <- sortInputTaxa(
    taxonIDs, rankName, refTaxon, NULL, NULL, NULL
)
taxaCount <- sortedInputTaxa %>% dplyr::count(supertaxon)
getCoreGene(
    rankName,
    taxaCore,
    fullProcessedProfile,
    taxaCount,
    var1Cutoff, var2Cutoff,
    percentCutoff, coreCoverage
)

data("mainLongRaw", package="PhyloProfile")
data <- mainLongRaw
inGroup <- c("ncbi9606", "ncbi10116")
variable <- colnames(data)[4]
compareTaxonGroups(data, inGroup, TRUE, variable, 0.05)

workflows.name: domain_architecture_plot
workflows.intent: Generate a domain architecture plot for a gene of interest and its orthologs.
input: gene.domains (protein domain architecture file containing domain annotations for genes of interest)
workflows.stages: 1. Parse domain input file using parseDomainInput ;; 2. Modify feature IDs ;; 3. Generate the domain plot using createArchiPlot and draw it using grid::grid.draw
workflows.code:
domainFile <- system.file(
    "extdata", "domainFiles/101621at6656.domains",
    package = "PhyloProfile", mustWork = TRUE
)
seedID <- "101621at6656"
orthoID <- "101621at6656|AGRPL@224129@0|224129_0:001955|1"
info <- c(seedID, orthoID)
domainDf <- parseDomainInput(seedID, domainFile, "file")
domainDf$feature_id_mod <- domainDf$feature_id
domainDf$feature_id_mod <- gsub("SINGLE", "LCR", domainDf$feature_id_mod)
domainDf$feature_id_mod[domainDf$feature_type == "coils"] <- "Coils"
domainDf$feature_id_mod[domainDf$feature_type == "seg"] <- "LCR"
domainDf$feature_id_mod[domainDf$feature_type == "tmhmm"] <- "TM"
plot <- createArchiPlot(info, domainDf, 9, 9)
grid::grid.draw(plot)
